nodes.name: Daily Scheduler - 7 AM IST
nodes.notes:
⏰ CRON TRIGGER

PURPOSE: Fires the entire workflow once per day at 7:00 AM IST

CRON EXPRESSION: 0 7 * * *
- 0 = minute (00)
- 7 = hour (7 AM)
- * = any day of month
- * = any month
- * = any day of week

TIMEZONE: Your n8n must be configured to IST (UTC+5:30)

WHAT TO SET:
1. Click this node
2. Verify "Trigger Interval" = "Cron"
3. Verify "Cron Expression" = "0 7 * * *"
4. Save

TO TEST:
- Click "Execute Node" to simulate a trigger
- Or click "Execute Workflow" at the top

TO CHANGE TIME:
- 8 AM: Change to "0 8 * * *"
- 6:30 AM: Change to "30 6 * * *"
- Every 6 hours: Change to "0 */6 * * *"

IMPORTANT: This triggers ALL downstream modules automatically!

nodes.name: Generate Execution Metadata
nodes.notes:
📋 EXECUTION METADATA GENERATOR

PURPOSE: Creates unique identifiers and timestamps for this workflow run

OUTPUT:
- runId: Unique ID for this execution
- executionId: n8n's internal execution ID
- timestamp: Current time in IST
- date, time: Separated date and time values

WHY NEEDED:
- Track which jobs were found in which run
- Deduplicate across multiple daily runs
- Create execution logs
- Debug issues by execution ID

WHAT TO SET:
✅ Nothing! This node works automatically.

JUST VERIFY:
- Click "Execute Node" to test
- Check the output has: runId, timestamp, date, time

NOTE: This metadata flows to ALL downstream modules

nodes.name: Health Check Endpoint
nodes.notes:
🏥 HEALTH CHECK (OPTIONAL)

PURPOSE: Verify n8n and dependent services are running

WHAT IT DOES:
- Pings a webhook endpoint to check if n8n responds
- Timeout after 5 seconds if no response
- Continues workflow even if fails (non-blocking)

WHAT TO SET:
1. Create a simple webhook in n8n:
   - New workflow → Add "Webhook" node
   - Path: /health-check
   - Response: {"status": "ok"}
   - Activate it

2. Update the URL in this node:
   - If n8n on localhost: http://localhost:5678/webhook/health-check
   - If on VPS: https://your-n8n-domain.com/webhook/health-check

OPTIONAL:
- You can disable this node (click node → Disable)
- Or delete it if you don't need health checks

ERROR HANDLING:
- If this fails, workflow still continues
- Check "Ignore SSL Issues" if using self-signed cert

nodes.name: Health Check OK?
nodes.notes:
✅ HEALTH CHECK VALIDATOR

PURPOSE: Check if health check endpoint responded with status 200

LOGIC:
- IF statusCode = 200 → Continue (healthy)
- ELSE → Log warning but continue anyway

WHAT TO SET:
✅ Nothing! This works automatically.

OUTPUTS:
- TRUE path: Health check passed
- FALSE path: Health check failed (will log warning)

NOTE: Workflow continues regardless of health check result

nodes.name: Log Health Warning
nodes.notes:
⚠️ HEALTH WARNING LOGGER

PURPOSE: If health check fails, log it but continue

WHAT TO SET:
✅ Nothing! Auto-logs warnings.

This outputs warning data that flows to the Logs tab in Google Sheets.

nodes.name: Log Health Success
nodes.notes:
✅ HEALTH SUCCESS LOGGER

PURPOSE: If health check succeeds, log success

WHAT TO SET:
✅ Nothing! Auto-logs success.

This outputs success data that flows to the Logs tab.

nodes.name: Merge Health Results
nodes.notes:
🔀 MERGE NODE

PURPOSE: Combine both health check paths (success + warning) back into one flow

WHY NEEDED:
- Both IF branches need to merge before continuing
- Ensures workflow continues regardless of health status

WHAT TO SET:
✅ Nothing! This merges automatically.

MODE: Merge By Position
- Takes first item from each input
- Continues with combined data

nodes.name: Format Log Entry
nodes.notes:
📝 FORMAT LOG ENTRY

PURPOSE: Structure the data to match Google Sheets Logs tab schema

MAPPING (matches 02-GOOGLE-SHEETS-SCHEMA.md):
- Column A: logId
- Column B: timestamp
- Column C: workflowRunId
- Column D: module
- Column E: action
- Column F: status
- Column G: recordsProcessed
- Column H: errorMessage
- Column I: retryCount
- Column J: notes

WHAT TO SET:
✅ Nothing! This formats automatically.

VERIFY:
- Click "Execute Node" and check output matches Logs schema

nodes.name: Write to Logs Tab
nodes.notes:
📊 WRITE TO GOOGLE SHEETS - LOGS TAB

PURPOSE: Log this workflow execution start to the Logs tab

⚠️ REQUIRED SETUP:

1. GET YOUR GOOGLE SHEET ID:
   - Open your Google Sheet
   - Copy the ID from URL: 
     https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/[THIS-IS-THE-ID]/edit

2. CONFIGURE THIS NODE:
   a) Click this node
   b) Under "Credential to connect with":
      - Click "Select Credential"
      - Click "+ Create New Credential"
      - Select "Google Sheets OAuth2 API"
      - Click "Connect my account"
      - Sign in with Google
      - Grant permissions
      - Save
   
   c) Under "Document":
      - Click "From list" or "By ID"
      - Paste your Sheet ID: YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID_HERE
   
   d) Under "Sheet":
      - Select "Logs" from dropdown
   
   e) Verify "Operation" = "Append or Update Row"
   
   f) Verify "Columns" mapping matches your sheet structure

3. TEST:
   - Click "Execute Node"
   - Check your Google Sheet → Logs tab
   - Should see a new row with execution data

TROUBLESHOOTING:
- "Sheet not found": Verify tab name is exactly "Logs"
- "Insufficient permissions": Re-authenticate Google credentials
- "Document not found": Verify Sheet ID is correct

assignments.name: message
assignments.value: Scheduler completed successfully. Ready to trigger Module 2 (Job Scraper).

nodes.name: Output to Module 2
nodes.notes:
🚀 OUTPUT TO NEXT MODULE

PURPOSE: Prepare clean output data to pass to Module 2 (Job Scraper)

OUTPUT DATA:
- runId: To tag all jobs scraped in this run
- timestamp: Current execution time
- date: Today's date (for deduplication)
- status: Ready (indicates Module 1 completed)

NEXT STEP:
- This data flows to Module 2 - Job Scraper
- Module 2 will use runId to tag all scraped jobs

WHAT TO SET:
✅ Nothing! This prepares output automatically.

IN MASTER WORKFLOW:
- This node connects to Module 2's start node
- Creates seamless data flow between modules
